name: Admin Accounting Cuentas de Cobro Center
description: Superuser manages all cuentas de cobro at /panel/accounting/collections (tab renamed from Cobros): status counters (emitidas/pagadas/vencidas/anuladas with totals), segmented status filter, table with numero/origen (hosting/proyecto/ingreso/otro)/cliente/total/emision/vence/estado (Vencida tint via is_overdue) and row actions: view linked income, download PDF, resend to client, mark paid (expected-linked accounts route through the Liquidar modal instead of a plain confirm), cancel (cancelling a hosting-linked account resumes its expiry notices; cancelling frees the linked income for a new cuenta). Since Aug 2026 Cliente and Proyecto are separate sortable, filterable columns and the row opens admin-accounting-collection-detail. Since Aug 2026 a cuenta issued with a zero-day payment term carries no due date at all: the Vence column stays empty and the row can never read as Vencida nor fall into that tab, because is_overdue derives from a date that no longer exists. Since F7 (Aug 2026) the Proyecto column answers with the LIVE project relation (the FK the filter already matches on) and the frozen customer_project_name snapshot only fills FK-null legacy rows, so the cell and the project filter can never disagree; two cuentas of one client can honestly differ (one linked, one blank — the reported evidence case) and a reload tells the same truth. The frozen snapshot stays the PDF's truth, untouched.
